dashboard.label: TA-backup Overview
dashboard.description: Collects backup-system health: last snapshot age and count for restic and borg repositories (from a config file), and active backup-related systemd timers

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-backup" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-backup. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-backup requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-backup", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-backup/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("backup.backup_timers") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("backup.configured") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("backup.timers_stale") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

index=main sourcetype="backup:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"configured\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=configured | spath input=o path=snapshots | spath input=o path=age_hours | spath input=o path=last_ts | table host k configured snapshots age_hours last_ts

panel.title: Stale backup timers (units past their cycle)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="backup:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=stale_timers{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "unit" | table host "unit"
